idea:
## Summary

Improve backend execution observability and resilience by (1) forcing Claude to use `--output-format stream-json` by default, (2) replacing wall-clock timeouts with inactivity-based (heartbeat) timeouts for both non-tmux and tmux execution paths, (3) extending the output normalizer to handle Claude's streaming NDJSON wire format, and (4) enriching timeout error types with idle-duration context.

## Requirements

### 1. Claude defaults to `stream-json`

- In `ensure_json_output_args` (`src/backend/mod.rs`): strip any existing `--output-format`/`--output-format=<val>` args, then append `--output-format stream-json`. Applies to fresh (no session_id) calls.
- In `effective_args_claude` (`src/backend/mod.rs`): same strip-and-replace, but change the hardcoded appended value from `json` to `stream-json`. Applies to resumed calls.
- Idempotent: exactly one `--output-format stream-json` pair must appear in final args regardless of input.
- No user config change required.

### 2. Output normalizer supports Claude stream-json

- Extend `normalize_output("claude", raw)` in `src/backend/output_normalizer.rs`.
- **Detection heuristic**: if trimmed output starts with `{`, attempt line-by-line parse; if any parsed line contains a `type` field, treat as stream-json. Otherwise fall back to existing single-object JSON path.
- **`normalize_claude_stream_json`** function:
  - Iterate NDJSON lines, dispatch on `type` field.
  - `content_block_delta`: accumulate text deltas into a `Vec<String>`; join at end (not last-wins).
  - `message_start`: extract `session_id` if present.
  - `message_delta` / final summary: extract `usage` metrics.
  - `content_block_stop`, `message_stop`: handle gracefully; skip unknown types.
- Fallback to raw text if no text accumulated from recognized events.
- Return `Err(ParseError)` if JSON parsed for at least one event but no assistant text was found.
- Existing single-object JSON and raw-text fallback paths remain intact.
- `normalize_output` must return a valid `NormalizedOutput` so orchestrator retry logic is unchanged.

### 3. Heartbeat-based timeout (non-tmux)

- Replace the single `tokio::time::sleep(timeout)` watchdog in `execute_streaming` (`src/backend/mod.rs`, lines ~600–616).
- Add `last_activity: Arc<AtomicU64>` initialized at process start (monotonic millis).
- Update `last_activity` on every `read_buf` call that returns >0 bytes (stdout loop) and every stderr read with >0 bytes.
- Watchdog loop: `sleep(poll_interval ~1s)`, check `now - last_activity > timeout_seconds`. On breach, kill process group.
- Populate `RalphError::BackendTimeout` with `idle_seconds` on timeout.

### 4. Heartbeat-based timeout (tmux)

- Refactor `wait_for_exit` in `src/backend/tmux.rs`:
  - Accept paths for exit file, stdout capture, and stderr capture.
  - On each poll, `stat` both capture files; any growth resets `last_activity`.
  - Timeout when `last_activity.elapsed() >= timeout_seconds` (not `started.elapsed()`).
- Update tmux shell command to write stderr to a separate capture file.
- Update `TmuxBackend::execute` (`src/backend/tmux_backend.rs`) to create/pass stderr capture path and include stderr bytes in persisted artifacts.

### 5. Enriched `BackendTimeout` error

- Extend `RalphError::BackendTimeout` in `src/error.rs` with:
  - `idle_seconds: u64`
  - `timeout_kind: TimeoutKind` enum (`Idle`, `Walltime`)
- Log at `warn` level on kill: backend name, role, attempt number, idle duration, total elapsed time.
- Update `src/workflow/orchestrator.rs` timeout error handling to use new fields.

### 6. Codex parity

- No separate Codex timeout implementation needed — Codex flows through the same `execute_streaming`/`TmuxBackend::execute` paths.
- Add at least one Codex-backed conformance test verifying shared inactivity-timeout semantics.

## Files to Modify

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `src/backend/mod.rs` | Arg rewriting in `ensure_json_output_args` + `effective_args_claude`; heartbeat watchdog in `execute_streaming` |
| `src/backend/tmux.rs` | `wait_for_exit` signature + heartbeat logic |
| `src/backend/tmux_backend.rs` | Stderr capture file; pass stdout/stderr paths; persist stderr artifacts |
| `src/backend/output_normalizer.rs` | `normalize_claude_stream_json` + detection routing |
| `src/error.rs` | Extend `BackendTimeout` with `idle_seconds`, `timeout_kind` |
| `src/workflow/orchestrator.rs` | Update timeout error handling/logging |
| `src/validate/tests_streaming.rs` | New conformance tests (extend existing module) |

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Fresh Claude calls emit `--output-format stream-json` with no user config
- [ ] Resumed Claude calls emit `--output-format stream-json` (replacing any prior value)
- [ ] Arg rewrite is idempotent — exactly one `--output-format` pair in final args
- [ ] `normalize_claude_stream_json` correctly accumulates text deltas (not last-wins)
- [ ] `normalize_claude_stream_json` extracts `session_id` from `message_start`
- [ ] `normalize_claude_stream_json` extracts usage from `message_delta`/summary event
- [ ] Detection heuristic routes stream-json vs single-object JSON correctly
- [ ] Existing single-object JSON and raw-text fallback paths pass existing tests
- [ ] Non-tmux: hanging backend (no output) times out after `timeout_seconds` of inactivity
- [ ] Non-tmux: actively streaming backend does NOT time out while heartbeats continue
- [ ] Tmux: same inactivity semantics via capture-file growth detection
- [ ] `RalphError::BackendTimeout` carries `idle_seconds` and `timeout_kind`
- [ ] Warn log on kill includes backend name, role, attempt, idle duration, total elapsed
- [ ] At least one Codex conformance test verifies shared inactivity-timeout path
- [ ] `max_walltime` is NOT added (out of scope)
- [ ] No config-file migration required; `timeout_seconds` key unchanged

## Non-Goals

- No changes to backend spec syntax (`backend(model)`)
- No template/prompt changes required from users
- No removal of existing parse-retry orchestration
- No `max_walltime` config key in this change
